scanner.title: Scanner Input
whereToLook: Make sure you created a Scanner object using System.in.
Read the number of tasks completed with nextInt() and store it in your tasks variable.
Print the prompt text exactly as shown in the README before reading the input.

conditionals.title: Conditional Statements (if / else if)
whereToLook: Use if / else if statements to compare the tasks variable against each value in the scoring table.
Check the boundaries of each condition so that every value from 0 to 5 maps to the correct percentage.
Make sure the percentage you display comes from the variable your conditional logic set, not a fixed value.

sourceChecks.name: Uses Scanner
sourceChecks.message: This challenge requires you to use a Scanner to read the number of tasks completed.

sourceChecks.name: Uses if statement
sourceChecks.message: This challenge requires you to use if / else if statements to determine the percentage from the number of tasks completed.

tests.name: Displays the input prompt
tests.expectedOutput: How many tasks did the astronaut complete?
tests.message: Your program should print the prompt 'How many tasks did the astronaut complete?' before reading input.

tests.name: 0 tasks completed
tests.message: When 0 tasks are completed, the astronaut's score should be 0 percent. Check the condition in your if statement for 0 tasks.

possibleErrors.message: Your output shows 100 percent even though 0 tasks were completed. Make sure your conditional logic looks at the value entered instead of always displaying the same percentage.
